previous.observation: Root actual own2462 canonical/guide, raw/fullWB and 5x coil: low ear/nape two-bead connection, shoulder-front overlap and 2 large plus true small/C improve; own open high palm, horizontal low palm, tilted head/torso and both whole ankle-strap shoes retained. P1 two distinct opaque inner-return faces are painted as separate deep gray bands; not black outlines or air to erase. New X01 input alone did not solve unlit material. Gray iris with source glints/no separate black dot retained, shade/line regularity P2. Hidden RGB cloud invisible on WB, no alpha fog claim. Independent agrees material P1; no user/dynamic/photography acceptance.
